summary: Narrow the terminal-cascade correction to run/generation dates and add lifecycle and three-member preservation controls. This entry supersedes the earlier fragment’s step-refinement and recovery wording.

replay.detail: Cascade timestamps change only when run or generation status changes. Direct claim timestamps keep normal semantics. The earlier step-refinement statement does not apply: both step terminalizers remain unchanged. No automatic replay or stored-row repair is added.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers or migration changes.

rules.detail: No claim validation, authority or checkpoint rules changes; no version is reserved.

compatibility.detail: Old binaries retain the timestamp defect. No pre-first-release mixed-build test condition is imposed; Operations owns moving every member onto the fixed build before separately scoped affected-tree reconstruction.

downtime.detail: Source correction adds no extra interruption. Any separate affected-tree reconstruction and its interruption remain Operations’ scope; no duration is claimed.

manual.detail: Supersedes the earlier rebuild/heal recommendation: Operations owns all-fixed-members then reviewed affected-tree reconstruction. Existing rows are not rewritten on open. This change authorizes no production recovery action and does not use healing as the code fix.

recovery.detail: Format unchanged. A rollback binary may reintroduce disagreement; no production rollback or reconstruction operation is introduced.
